purpose: Job-level CI results imported for review-artifacts/gen_license_chain_evidence.py and review-artifacts/gen_issuer_offline_evidence.py; written from the GitHub REST API, every value verifiable at the URLs below. No secrets: masked fingerprints only.

reviewed_head.role: PR #34 head (baseline / negative control of the fix comparison)

fix_commit.role: owner-side issuer fixes requested in the review (build.ps1 + .gitignore). Lives on the session branch, not inside PR #34; delivered as review-artifacts/license-issuer-fixes.patch.

tools/license-issuer/build.ps1.change: loopback bind, fail-closed launcher, temp-dir smoke test

scope_notes: The session branch is based on main, so this run uses main's ci.yml: it does NOT contain the three license-chain steps or the compose-pilot-license-chain artifact that PR #34's workflow adds (checked: no such artifact in the run's artifact list).

CI never executes tools/license-issuer/build.ps1, run-gui.bat or run-html.bat - the .bat files only exist after the bundle build. The Windows job covers the PowerShell engine and the installer smoke on windows-latest.
Therefore this run is evidence that the change does not break the repository's CI, not evidence about the issuer bundle at runtime.
